_comment: Homepage 'Partner Ecosystem' section: the TYPES of businesses the network is designed for. No organization names here — named, approved partners belong in data/partners-ecosystem.json (launch-gated). 'i18n' is the key prefix in i18n/*.json (<prefix>.t / <prefix>.d); name/description are the English fallback. 'category' must match an id in 'categories'.

entries.name: Independent Hotels & Ryokan
entries.description: Properties across Asia exploring direct distribution relationships.

entries.name: Hotel Groups
entries.description: Multi-property groups managing distribution across brands and markets.

entries.name: Wholesalers & Bedbanks
entries.description: Third-party suppliers that can extend inventory beyond direct supply.

entries.name: OTAs & Marketplaces
entries.description: Online travel sellers. Some also provide inventory as supplier OTAs.

entries.name: Travel Agencies & DMCs
entries.description: Leisure, corporate and destination specialists sourcing accommodation.

entries.name: Travel Apps & Membership Platforms
entries.description: Consumer apps, loyalty and subscription programs offering stays.

entries.name: Channel Managers, PMS & CRS
entries.description: Systems that connect properties' rates and availability to the network.
